messages:
mira: Quick heads-up — opened PR #482 to update the Nebula3b model card. Main changes: add supported long-context example, clarify sequence limits, and swap in the SDK v3 snippet for generation. Can reviewers please skim for compatibility notes and bench links?

alex: Thanks! I'll check the limits section first. Are we still recommending max 64k tokens for Aurora variants or lowering for quantized builds?

mira: Good q — core note is 64k for FP16 on Orion-class infra, but quantized variants should list 32k as a practical ceiling and call out degraded perf. I added a small compatibility table under "Limits".

sam.k: I pulled the branch and saw one dead link: the benchmarking results link -> /benchmarks/nebula3b/old-report returns 404. I left a comment on the PR with the correct path (https://internal.redwood/bench/nebula3b/2026-02).

leo: On the SDK snippet: the current example uses the old sync client. We should show streaming + async snippet for SDK v3 to match Console examples. Suggest 2 short examples: quick generate and streaming with timeout.

mira: Agreed. I replaced the sync example with this async snippet — pls check for accuracy: 
```python
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient()
resp = await client.generate(model="nebula3b", prompt="Summarize the doc updates", max_tokens=150)
print(resp.text)
```

alex: That looks fine. Add a note: "Requires SDK v3.0+" and link to the migration guide. Also add a sentence about fallback to a smaller variant if batch size > 1 on quantized nodes.

sam.k: Also flagged a tiny wording nit in compatibility notes: we say "no embedding support" but older minor variants do have a lightweight embed API — recommend we say "no guaranteed embeddings for quantized variants".

mira: Good catch — updated wording on the PR.

doc-bot: link-checker: scanned changed files in PR #482 — 1 warning (bench link updated), 0 errors. CI: docs-build passed.

leo: One more: Benchmarks section references a perf chart image named nebula3b-202602.png — make sure the alt text includes the model, sequence length, and hardware (e.g., "Nebula3b perf, 64k seq, A100-80GB"). Accessibility check.

mira: Done. I added alt text and a short caption with hardware + date.

alex: I'll give a final review in ~30 mins, focusing on limits table and the fallback sentence. If no blockers we can merge and publish the catalog change during the noon docs deploy.

sam.k: Lgtm from my side once the bench link path is fixed (thanks).

mira: Thanks team — aim to merge before the noon deploy. @doc-bot can you queue the doc-changelog entry after merge?

doc-bot: changelog-bot: will add entry to /docs/CHANGELOG.md after merge (title: "Nebula3b: long-context example, SDK v3 snippet, limits clarifications").

leo: :thumbsup:
